svg.font-family: Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: 01-architecture-layers
svg.text: Architecture: Go packages and the GUI boundary
One Go module; only internal/gui imports Wails. Import rules enforced by make layers (internal/archtest)
No subcommand: gui.Run opens the window. sessions, folders, tunnels,
version and mcp run headless (no GTK, no webview).
Vue 3 + Tailwind + xterm.js, built by Vite Plus (vp build --mode desktop)
Wails v3 window and bound service (App): bindings, events, trust and password prompts.
Composes the core; may import any internal/* package.
GUI boundary: only internal/gui imports Wails (archtest guiOnly)
TLS trust for RDP and FTPS: system CA, pinned
Shared directory entry for the file browsers
layers_test.go: each package's allowed module imports; a new package fails until it is listed,
and Wails only in internal/gui. skins_test.go: every skin in frontend/src/themes defines the
make check: gofmt + go vet. make test: unit
internal/rdpconn → its pure-Go RDP client package
every other package → no module packages (third-party libraries only)
